headline: Alphabet Shares Fall Following Revenue Miss and Wider Cash Burn
summary: Alphabet shares declined after the tech giant missed revenue estimates and reported a negative free cash flow of $11.62 billion.
why: Alphabet is a dominant mega-cap technology company whose financial health and capital expenditure trends heavily influence broader tech sector valuations.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Missing consensus revenue estimates and reporting high cash burn directly reduces near-term equity valuation appeal.

why_moved: Lower-than-expected revenue figures and increased cash burn triggered a sell-off in Alphabet shares.
